_note: The capture page shows the first 3 themes with enabled=true. Teepu approves the final 3 after the Step 1 look test.
avoid: No extra people, no text, no hands near the face, no fast motion.

themes.label: Future City
themes.prompt: The person from the photo walks slowly towards camera through a sunlit futuristic city of white curved towers and turquoise water, gentle dolly in, soft cinematic light, keep the face and clothing exactly as in the photo, realistic, 5 seconds.

themes.label: Desert Gold
themes.prompt: The person from the photo stands on a golden sand dune at sunset, wind moving their clothes, slow orbit around them, warm film grain, keep the face exactly as in the photo, realistic.

themes.label: Neon Studio
themes.prompt: The person from the photo turns to camera and smiles in a dark studio with magenta and teal light streaks, slow push in, keep the face exactly as in the photo, realistic, clean background.

themes.label: Labs Garden
themes.prompt: The person from the photo stands in a glowing digital garden of light flowers that bloom around them, slow crane up, keep the face exactly as in the photo, realistic.
